bullets: Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for institutional credit on Morpho, end to end.
Act as Morpho's domain expert on the institutional market. Go deep with issuers, asset managers, banks, custodians and brokers on how they finance and lend assets, represent…
Decide which issuers and asset types come first, which wait and which Morpho declines, and make the trade-offs explicit.
Judge which partner-specific requests become standard capabilities many institutions can use, and make the build or partner call for each.
Work as a peer to the protocol team on design trade-offs, bringing legal and risk in early on custody, transfer restrictions, valuation and liquidation for each asset type.
Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for credit in payments on Morpho.
Act as Morpho's domain expert on the payments industry. Go deep with payments companies and lenders on how money moves and settles, represent Morpho with them, and turn…
Prioritize market opportunities across networks, partner types, and regions, and make the trade-offs explicit.
Drive each initiative from problem definition through launch and adoption, across teams you do not manage. Define success before launch, measured in active loans and how often…
Create scalable products and integrations that any acquirer, issuer or lender can adopt, and make the build or partner call for each piece.
